notes: Primary source: Panasonic official leaflet/spec sheet SP-C-UE160ENU1 (Oct 2024), cross-checked against pro-av.panasonic.net/en/products/aw-ue160/spec.html and the AW-UE160WP operating manual's rear-panel diagram (via ManualsLib). Covers both AW-UE160W (Pearl White) and AW-UE160K (Black) color variants, which are electrically/connector-identical. RS-422 and LAN both use RJ-45 physical connectors but serve different protocols (control vs IP/PoE); RS-422 connector closest match is rj45 with accepts:[rs422] noting the actual signal protocol. DC IN is described in the manual as a 'jack type' power connector; exact barrel dimensions not published, so mapped to the closest listed connector id (dc-barrel). SFP+ port is bidirectional: it carries ST 2110 uncompressed/JPEG XS video+audio output (multiple virtual outputs) plus one RETURN video input, and requires the separately-sold AW-SFU60/AW-SFU60G software key for full ST2110/JPEG XS/NDI High Bandwidth activation. Camera also has front and rear tally lamps (not a physical connector/port, so omitted) and a SERVICE LINK port mentioned in the manual's rear-panel legend for factory/service use only (not a user-facing signal or power port, omitted from the port list). Not rack-mountable (desktop/ceiling-mount PTZ camera), so rackUnits omitted.

ports.name: G/L IN
ports.note: Genlock reference input; BBS (Black Burst Sync) and tri-level sync compatible

ports.name: AUDIO INPUT 1
ports.note: 3-pin XLR female, balanced, switchable Mic/Line input

ports.name: AUDIO INPUT 2
ports.note: 3-pin XLR female, balanced, switchable Mic/Line input

ports.name: 3G SDI OUT2/PM
ports.note: SMPTE424M / SMPTE292M, 75-ohm; PM = program monitor output

ports.name: HDMI
ports.note: HDMI 2.0 connector, 4:2:2/10-bit; HDCP and VIERA Link not supported

ports.name: SFP+
ports.note: SFP+ compliant, single fiber; carries SMPTE ST 2110 video/audio (requires optional AW-SFU60G key); return video input also carried here

ports.name: USB3.0 HOST
ports.note: USB 3.0 host port for 5G mobile router with USB tethering support

ports.name: LAN
ports.note: LAN connector for IP control/video; 100BASE-TX/1000BASE-T; also accepts PoE++ (IEEE802.3bt, DC42-57V) for camera power

ports.name: RS-422
ports.note: CONTROL IN RS-422A over RJ-45 connector, for device/pan-tilt control

ports.name: DC IN
ports.note: 12VDC +/-10% (10.8V-13.2V) jack-type power input; alternative to PoE++ power via LAN port
